title: The Timeline revamp PR added IssueBulkUpdateDateEndpoint, which fetches issues by caller-supplied ids without filtering by the URL's workspace and project, so a member of any project can change start/target dates of any issue on the instance.

findings.explanation: The IssueBulkUpdateDateEndpoint allows any user with ADMIN or MEMBER role to POST updates for arbitrary issue IDs without verifying that those issues belong to the specified workspace/project or that the user has ownership/participation rights. This is a classic IDOR scenario. The IssueDetailEndpoint similarly fetches issues by workspace slug and project ID but does not enforce that the requesting user is a member of that workspace/project, relying solely on the allow_permission decorator which may not check membership. Both endpoints lack ownership checks on the protected operation.
